info.name: Pied Web mail scheduler
info.summary: Sends scheduled mail and wakes due reminders without a browser
info.description: Reads the Scheduled and Reminders folders of each mailbox whose NextSnapMail credentials are stored in Nextcloud. It sends due outgoing messages at most once and moves due reminders back to Inbox as unread. No message, recipient or credential is stored by this app.
info.author: Robin Delattre
